items.title: Chester Zardis Interview, 1966-03-09
items.q: Well Punch was a pretty good man. He was a pretty good man, but I mean he wasn't like the rest of them fellas.

ctx.x: How did Punch play in those days?

Well Punch was a pretty good man. He was a pretty good man, but I mean he wasn't like the rest of them fellas. I mean he plays nice. And he's style of playing. But I mean he didn't have that style like Rosetta Boyd, you know what I mean? Like Rene and those kind of things. Rene and Chris Kelly. Yeah. Now I used to take, when we'd be on advertising, after we started getting them trucks, you take like Rene. Now he'd take old Rene, now he'd get out there, sometime he gets on out there on the ground. Sometime he sat…
Yeah I worked with Sidney, I worked with Sidney Desbeam.

items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1958-05-24
items.q: Who was in the band that time? Chester. He's here. Myself.

ctx.x: Who was, who would know? Somebody must have in the band probably kept up with it. Who's still there? Jack Carey.
Well, that's the trouble. Who was in the band that time? Chester. He's here. Myself. Johnny was with us a while.

items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1957-multiple
items.q: Oh, yeah, Chester. Chester Zadis. That's who he had on bass violin.

ctx.x: Jack Carey on trombone, I was on trumpet. And they had, first they had a boy on a kind of name Robeshow. He was kind of this old man Robeshow, but he was a young fella. Then after that, George Boyd come in there with him. And I don't know who Jack, I mean Jack had on bass. Oh, yeah, Chester. Chester Zadis. That's who he had on bass violin. So, when I got in my band, for some reason I had George Boyd, Aiden Morris, Joe Gable on bass, Walter Preston on guitar, and me on trumpet.
Who was guitar with Carey? What did you say? With Carey?

items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1959-08-20
items.q: Chester Zadis played bass with him, why?

ctx.x: Who did Celestan have in the rhythm section?

Well, that lady on piano, Clown's sister, Camilla Todd, is that her name? Mm-hmm. Now, who was on bass? Chester Zadis played bass with him, why? But before that he had George Foster, that's right. He was- He was-
He was the same one was with Jack Carey, huh? Yeah, same one.
